Annotation Interface GenerateMavenMojo

@Documented @Retention(CLASS) @Target(TYPE) @Repeatable(GenerateMavenMojo.List.class) public @interface GenerateMavenMojo
An annotation that triggers the generation of Maven Mojo. A plugin can include multiple Mojos.
Since:
1.0.x
Author:
Andriy Dmytruk

  • Element Details

    • namePrefix

      String namePrefix
      The prefix to use for the mojo name. For example if the prefix is Test, mojo will be generated as TestMojo. The default is the annotated class name.
      Returns:
      The prefix
      Default:
      ""

    • source

      String source
      Returns:
      The task configuration class name that has PluginTask annotation

    • micronautPlugin

      boolean micronautPlugin
      Returns:
      Whether to extend abstract micronaut mojo.
      Default:
      true

    • parameterPrefix

      String parameterPrefix
      The prefix to use for parameters generated in Maven Mojo.
      Returns:
      The property prefix
      See Also:
      • globalParameters()
      Default:
      ""

    • globalParameters

      String[] globalParameters
      Specify which properties should be defined as parameters. Parameters will be configured with @Property(parameter = ) in Maven. All the parameters will be prefixed with parameterPrefix();
      To specify an alternative parameter name, provide it by an equals sign, like "myProperty=my-property".
      Returns:
      The parameters list
      Default:
      {}

    • enabledPropertyName

      String enabledPropertyName
      Set the name for the property to enable or disable the mojo. The default is ${parameterPrefix}.enabled.
      Returns:
      The name for property
      Default:
      ""
